numbers.source_quote: 公司计提各项减值准备共计 8,815.45 万元
实现归属于母公司所有者的净利润约 6,700.00 万元
扣除非经常性损益后归属于母公司所有者的净利润约-4,800.00 万元
公允价值变动收益约 9,400 万元
2025 年上半年归属于母公司所有者的净利润-7,801.00 万元
(derived) 预告归母净利 6,700.00 + 本次减值 8,815.45

key_points.point: Total impairment 8,815.45 万元, reducing H1 2026 net profit attributable to the parent and period-end attributable equity by the same amount

Forecast net profit attributable to the parent ~6,700.00 万元 (prior-year period -7,801.00 万元, loss-to-profit turnaround); ex-non-recurring net profit ~-4,800.00 万元 (still a loss, narrowed year-on-year)
The non-recurring gain is mainly fair-value gains of ~9,400 万元 from indirect equity investments via private funds
Cross-check: the impairment is already inside the forecast profit; without it, attributable net profit would be roughly 15,515.45 万元 (6,700.00+8,815.45)
Both filings were disclosed the same day (2026-08-14) and both datasets are unaudited, subject to the formal interim report / annual audit

notes: Source confusion is the crux: same company, same day, adjacent filing numbers (2026-044/045), and the impairment figure (8,815.45) sits near the forecast figures (6,700.00/9,400) in magnitude - attributing the impairment number to forecast.txt, or the profit numbers to impairment.txt, loses citation points (source_file validation). Dropping the minus sign on -4,800.00 or reversing the loss-to-profit direction must lose points; N6 is the only derived number (0.5% tolerance). Evidence quotes remain in the original Chinese.
